name: The Vietnam War in Color: Secrets, Shadows, Sacrifice
original_name: The Vietnam War in Color: Secrets, Shadows, Sacrifice
overview: A nation shaped by war for thousands of years fights to overcome the oppression of foreign powers. Ho Chi Minh embraces the power of communism and the rage of revolution, leading to the historic Battle of Dien Bien Phu. This decisive clash ends the tyranny of French colonial rule and marks the birth of a new Vietnam.
